hypothesis: On a positive prior SOXX path, high SOXL-specific tracking-error volatility reduces the next-open equal-nominal-beta SOXL-minus-SOXX fee-net action value. This is an interaction of path direction and product fragility, not a new market source.
decision_clock: prior full session close available for next session 09:29; no current-day minute input

source_features.signed_path_efficiency_21: sum prior21 SOXX log returns / sum prior21 absolute SOXX log returns
source_features.soxl_tracking_error_vol_21: sample std prior21 SOXL log return minus log1p(3*SOXX daily pct return)
source_features.soxx_vol20: sample std prior20 SOXX pct returns

target: per-day equal-weight mean of saved same-event whole-share Tiered relative_value_soxl_minus_soxx on paired-funded and year-mature rows; exploratory conditional label, not own-account alpha
evaluation: 2018-10-15 through 2019-12-31 training; 2020-01-01 through 2020-12-31 one-time development test; do not access 2021+ labels
model: Ridge alpha=10, train-only standardization, intercept, equal weight per day; exactly one control and one candidate fit
source_gate: At least 200 paired mature training days in 2019 and 200 in 2020, all features finite, previous-session clock and original formula identity; interaction residual nonconstant beyond controls.
information_gate: On 2020 day-equal labels, candidate MSE strictly below control and negative interaction coefficient.
action_gate: At the first source intent of each 2020 day, compare sign-predicted SOXL versus SOXX selection against control on both-funded known local outcomes; require positive incremental fee-net mean and a positive 2.5th percentile of 10-session circular-block bootstrap. Preserve all no-fill/unknown days as unknown; this is conditional diagnostic, not live-intent proof.
stop: If source, information or action gate fails, close this fixed interaction without sign, alpha, window, threshold, year or size rescue; do not read 2021+ target outcomes.
